term: The new council term runs from November 15, 2026 to November 14, 2030.
intro: This is a non-partisan resource guide to the council races in the Town of Midland, the Town of Penetanguishene, the Township of Tiny, the Township of Tay and the Town of Wasaga Beach. It sets out how to vote in each municipality and who is running for each office. It does not endorse any candidate.
voters_list_note: Municipal voters' lists are prepared from the register kept by Elections Ontario. The Province's 2026 voters' guide says that on or after September 1, 2026, you apply to your municipal clerk to update or add your information, and you have until the close of voting on October 26, 2026. In Tiny, online registration closes Monday, October 12.
